articles.title_en: Stated Preferences with Survey Consequentiality and Outcome Uncertainty: A Split Sample Discrete Choice Experiment
The Effect of Natural Disasters on Hotel Demand, Supply and Labour Markets: Evidence from the La Palma Volcano Eruption
articles.title_cn: 自然灾害对酒店需求、供给和劳动力市场的影响：来自拉帕尔马火山喷发的证据
articles.abstract_en: Natural disasters are an important deterrent factor for tourism activities from both supply and demand perspectives. This paper studies the short-term effect of a volcano eruption on hotel demand, supply and hospitality labour in La Palma (Spain), an island economy that is highly dependent on the tourism sector. Based on a monthly panel dataset, we employ seemingly unrelated difference-in-differences (SUR-DiD) to identify the distinct responses of these three outcomes both during and post eruption. We are particularly interested in examining the asymmetry in their elasticities to the shock, which serve as indicators of disaster resilience. Potential spillover effects on nearby islands are also examined. We find that the eruption resulted in significant yet asymmetrical drops in international demand, number of hotels opened, and hospitality workers hired. Our findings inform about the resilience of the tourism industry to natural disasters, offering relevant insights about heterogeneous effects depending on exposure to the event.
articles.abstract_cn: 自然灾害从供给和需求两方面都是旅游活动的重要阻碍因素。本文研究了火山喷发对西班牙拉帕尔马（一个高度依赖旅游业的岛屿经济体）酒店需求、供给和酒店业劳动力的短期影响。基于月度面板数据集，我们采用似不相关双重差分法（SUR-DiD）来识别这三个结果在喷发期间和喷发后的不同反应。我们特别关注检验它们对冲击弹性的不对称性，这可以作为灾害恢复力的指标。我们还考察了对邻近岛屿的潜在溢出效应。我们发现，火山喷发导致国际需求、开业酒店数量和雇佣的酒店业工人数量显著但不对称地下降。我们的研究结果揭示了旅游业对自然灾害的恢复力，为根据事件暴露程度的不同异质性效应提供了相关见解。

articles.title_en: Nutrition and Climate Policies in the European Union: Friends or Enemies?
articles.title_cn: 欧盟的营养与气候政策：朋友还是敌人？
articles.abstract_en: The European Union (EU) Green Deal and its Farm to Fork Strategy are intended to promote sustainable food systems to achieve EU climate-neutrality by 2050. The Farm to Fork action plan also foresees the introduction of a harmonized mandatory front-of-pack nutrition labelling scheme in 2023. The EU countries have yet to reach agreement on the nutrition labelling scheme, which will also have environmental impacts. This article raises the question of whether at the European level, countries should seek agreements on both climate mitigation and nutrition policies (full agreement as in the case of the Green Deal) or should negotiate separate climate and nutrition policy agreements (as for the nutritional labelling). To address this question, this paper develops a game-theoretic model with multiple countries where each country implements a climate policy and a nutrition policy. We compare the consequences in terms of total emissions, the level of the nutrition policy and the welfare under different institutional arrangements of a non-cooperative equilibrium, full agreement, and three alternative agreements. Our results show in particular that full agreement always leads to the lowest total emissions at the expense of the level of nutrition policy in some cases. In an extension of our analysis, we show that agreements that include cooperation over nutrition policies do not necessarily imply formation of a larger coalition of signatory countries, even if a nutrition policy has positive or negative impacts on emissions.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟绿色协议及其“从农场到餐桌”战略旨在促进可持续食品体系，以实现欧盟到2050年的气候中和目标。“从农场到餐桌”行动计划还预计在2023年引入统一的强制性前包装营养标签方案。欧盟国家尚未就该营养标签方案达成一致，该方案也将对环境产生影响。本文提出的问题是，在欧洲层面，各国是否应就气候减缓政策和营养政策寻求全面协议（如绿色协议中的全面协议），还是应分别就气候和营养政策协议进行谈判（如营养标签的情况）。为解决这一问题，本文构建了一个包含多个国家的博弈论模型，每个国家实施一项气候政策和一项营养政策。我们比较了非合作均衡、全面协议以及三种替代协议等不同制度安排下的总排放量、营养政策水平和福利后果。我们的结果特别表明，全面协议总是导致最低的总排放量，但在某些情况下以牺牲营养政策水平为代价。在我们分析的扩展中，我们表明，即使营养政策对排放有正面或负面影响，包含营养政策合作的协议也不一定意味着签署国联盟的扩大。

articles.title_en: Mosquitoes and Potatoes: How Local Climatic Conditions Impede Development
articles.title_cn: 蚊子与土豆：地方气候条件如何阻碍发展
articles.abstract_en: The historical diffusion of the potato in the Old World serves as an example of the contribution of technological innovations to socio-economic growth and development (Nunn and Qian in Q J Econ 126(2):593–650, 2011). Climate-related diseases, on the other hand, might offset some of these benefits. Here we examine the long-term impact of malaria on the potato-driven growth of the population and urbanization in the Old World during the 18th and 19th centuries. We exploit local variations in environmental suitability both for potato and for malaria transmission to estimate and compare the impact of potato cultivation on population and urbanization in highly endemic to non-endemic areas at a high level of spatial disaggregation. We show that local climate conditions ideal for malaria transmission counteracted the potential benefits of introducing the potato to the Old World, which are conversely found to be strong and positive in non-endemic regions. These results highlight the interplay between technological change, public health, and development outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 土豆在旧世界的历史传播是技术创新对 socio-economic 增长和发展贡献的一个例子（Nunn 和 Qian 在 Q J Econ 126(2):593-650, 2011）。另一方面，与气候相关的疾病可能会抵消其中一些好处。在这里，我们考察了在 18 和 19 世纪，疟疾对旧世界中土豆驱动的人口和城市化增长的长期影响。我们利用土豆和疟疾传播的环境适宜性的地方差异，在高空间分辨率下估计并比较了在高度流行区与非流行区土豆种植对人口和城市化的影响。我们表明，适合疟疾传播的地方气候条件抵消了将土豆引入旧世界的潜在好处，而这些好处在非流行地区反而被发现是强烈且正向的。这些结果凸显了技术变革、公共卫生和发展成果之间的相互作用。

articles.title_en: Willingness-to-Pay for Energy Efficiency: Evidence from the European Common Market
articles.title_cn: 能源效率的支付意愿：来自欧洲共同市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the willingness-to-pay for energy efficiency by exploiting variation across products and countries within the EU market for household appliances. Based on scanner data at product-level, I use the hedonic method to estimate implicit prices for energy efficiency and derive implicit discount rates. The paper argues that the implicit price will be underestimated when energy consumption is not only a determinant of operating cost but also is positively associated with other features of a product. The empirical analysis confirms that estimates of the willingness-to-pay are higher when this effect is accounted for in the estimation. This is especially true of product types for which the heterogeneity of usage intensity is low. The results thus indicate that the energy efficiency gap is smaller than found in earlier studies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过利用欧盟家用电器市场中产品和国家之间的差异，探讨了能源效率的支付意愿。基于产品层面的扫描数据，我使用特征价格法估计能源效率的隐含价格，并推导出隐含贴现率。本文认为，当能源消耗不仅是运营成本的决定因素，而且与产品的其他特征正相关时，隐含价格将被低估。实证分析证实，当在估计中考虑这一效应时，支付意愿的估计值更高。这对于使用强度异质性较低的产品类型尤其如此。因此，结果表明能源效率差距比早期研究中发现的要小。
